notes: Pixel coordinates in globe-in-hands.webp. Multiply by (rendered width / image.width) for any other size, e.g. 640 / image.width for globe-in-hands-640.webp. The arms are cut off by the bottom and right edges of the image, as on the poster; the glass dome is translucent (alpha ~0.75-0.97), everything else is opaque.
